dedupeResult: The active pull-request dataset was searched for both station names, domains, the KEXP Music Department mailbox and each canonical submission page before insertion. No prior KEXP or WXPN canonical music-submission opportunity was found. KEXP's contact page, submission guidelines, Music Department mailbox and optional direct-DJ outreach guidance were consolidated into one station-level route, with only md@kexp.org queued. WXPN's main Music Director route was kept separate from its locally focused Local Show route, and only the general airplay route was added.
emailVerificationLevel: KEXP publishes md@kexp.org in plaintext on its official Contact and Submission Guidelines pages specifically for rotation consideration. Verification covered valid syntax, exact stated Music Department purpose, first-party kexp.org domain alignment and current official-site activity. WXPN's official Contact page presents a first-party Email Music Director action for airplay submissions, but the destination was not exposed in passive plaintext; it was not decoded, guessed or stored. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, EPK, stream, download link, audio file, attachment, biography, lyric sheet, credits, metadata, personal information, rights declaration or payment was sent. No non-plaintext destination was decoded or guessed, no local eligibility was claimed, and no CAPTCHA, anti-bot, authentication, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
